order_confirmed.subject: Order {order_code} confirmed · BAKĒD
order_confirmed.intro: Thanks for your order. Order {order_code} for a total of {total} is confirmed and being prepared.
order_confirmed.footer: A question? Reply to this email or reach us at support@baked.ci.

order_delivered.subject: Order {order_code} delivered · BAKĒD
order_delivered.body: Your order {order_code} was delivered successfully. Thanks for shopping with us!

magic_link.subject: Your BAKĒD sign-in link
magic_link.body: Here's your secure sign-in link. It expires in {minutes} minutes.
magic_link.warning: If you didn't request this link, please ignore this email.

otp.subject: BAKĒD verification code
otp.body: Your verification code is: {code}. It expires in {minutes} minutes.
otp.warning: Never share this code with anyone. BAKĒD staff will never ask you for it.

staff_invite.subject: You're invited to join {business_name} on BAKĒD
staff_invite.body: {inviter} has invited you to join the {business_name} team as {role}.

supplier_approved.subject: Welcome to BAKĒD 🎉 Your application has been approved
supplier_approved.body: Great news! Your application to become a BAKĒD supplier has been approved. You can now sign in to your dashboard and start selling.

supplier_rejected.subject: Update on your BAKĒD application
supplier_rejected.body: Thanks for applying to BAKĒD. Unfortunately, we're unable to move forward with your application at this time. Reason: {reason}
